rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: tightest 0.000 mm between pen_clamp_1 and pen_clamp_2 at tool_z = -16.0 mm (121 moving pairs)
rows.limit: no overlap, and every declared clearance held
rows.source: 7 poses across -16.0 to +0.0 mm. Axes are swept one at a time from home, so a crash needing two axes off-home is not covered.

rows.subject: axis tool_z
rows.measured: tool reaches -16.0 to +0.0 mm, work area -16.0 to +0.0 mm (+0.0 mm margin)
rows.source: tool point swept along the axis over declared travel; this is kinematic reach, not whether the head can physically get there without hitting something — that is the sweep rule

rows.subject: pose dispense
rows.limit: every axis declared in AXES, each position inside its travel
rows.source: POSES and AXES in assembly.py

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: 48.0 × 75.0 mm across 2 bodies at z = 54.50 (pico_jet_1, pico_jet_2)
rows.limit: at least 5 mm in both axes
rows.source: union of the contact patches at the lowest plane; a span near zero in either axis is a line or point contact and will tip. Does not test the centre of mass.

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: 2 bodies on the plane, 15 above it, none below
rows.source: the lowest plane is taken as the ground, so nothing can be below it by construction; this row records the split

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: no mass for 3 of 17 bodies: t8_nut (bought part 't8_nut' declares no mass_g with a mass_source); tool_coupling (bought part 'coupling' declares no mass_g with a mass_source); tool_screw (bought part 't8_screw' declares no mass_g with a mass_source)
rows.source: made: volume x density of its MATERIAL; bought: declared mass_g with a mass_source; a stock body has none

rows.subject: assembly
rows.source: spec.toml

rows.subject: axis tool_z
rows.measured: no mass for t8_nut (bought part 't8_nut' declares no mass_g with a mass_source); the others weigh 1861.4 g (tool_block 50.0 g (HIWIN MG series catalog GW-11-5-EN-2207-K, table 3.79: weight 0.050 kg); tool_carrier 246.2 g; pen_clamp_1 115.7 g; pen_clamp_2 115.7 g; eco_pen_1 280.0 g (ViscoTec eco-PEN300 data: 280 g); eco_pen_2 280.0 g (ViscoTec eco-PEN300 data: 280 g); pico_jet_1 362.0 g (Nordson EFD PICO Pulse data sheet: 362 g without cable); pico_jet_2 362.0 g (Nordson EFD PICO Pulse data sheet: 362 g without cable); height_sensor 30.0 g (Panasonic HG-C1000 series page: 30 g without cable); tool_ear 19.7 g)
rows.source: spec.toml [[mass]] #1

rows.subject: axis tool_z

rows.subject: eco_pen
rows.measured: ViscoTec preeflow eco-PEN300 (art. 20505): L 216, dia 33, 280 g, 0-6 bar operating, 0.12-1.48 ml/min, 1 ul: https://unchainedrobotics.de/en/products/end-of-arm-effectors/end-of-arm-tools/dispensers/vieweg-volume-valve-preeflow-eco-pen450 (eco-PEN range page) and ViscoTec's product page

rows.source: confirm with callipers on arrival, then set VERIFIED

rows.subject: pico_jet
rows.measured: declared unconfirmed: Nordson EFD PICO Pulse data sheet: 22 W x 120 H x 75 L mm, 362 g without cable, 35 bar, M4x0.7 mounting, 0.5 nl, 1000 Hz: https://assets.testequity.com/te1/Documents/pdf/nordson/Nordson-EFD_Pico-Pulse-Contact-Dispense-Valve_DataSheet_0624.pdf (the contact-valve sheet; the jet's own sheet gives the same body per a search excerpt)

rows.source: MEASURED route

rows.subject: t8_screw

rows.subject: tool_block
rows.measured: HIWIN MG series catalog GW-11-5-EN-2207-K, table 3.79 (page 97): MGN12H, 45.4 x 27, H 13 above the rail's base and H1 3.0 clear of it, four M3 x 3.5 holes 20 x 20 apart, weight 0.050 kg; it runs on the 12 wide rail of table 3.81. An envelope: no balls, end caps, seals or grease nipple.

A 42.3 mm square flange, pilot 22.0 x 2.03, shaft 5.0 out 23.88 from the face, four M3 holes 4.5 deep on a 31.0 square.
